digest.component_or_area: Plan review criteria and container pass
propositions: Plan review certified tickets with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children, allowing contradictions to surface only during implementation rather than at review gate

No existing criterion owns the concern of whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable; this requires a new coherence-facet criterion named ac-satisfiability
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire effectively because it receives only child ids and titles, not their acceptance-criteria content needed to test whether siblings cover parent criteria

The sibling roster expression is duplicated across three independent callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), creating divergence risk and corrupting dogfooding data for downstream posture decisions

The sibling roster must be moved from per-pairing instructions into the byte-stable system prompt prefix to be cached, and its token cost must be included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate for bin-packing and warm-gate decisions
